corrections_to_earlier_claims.claim: validate=False will remove the load cost
corrections_to_earlier_claims.why_wrong: the validity checks live inside the executor's apply, not the decoder's optional verification

corrections_to_earlier_claims.measured: 2x at first, 98x after the second replay was removed
corrections_to_earlier_claims.why_wrong: the 630x micro-benchmark timed PackedMolecularGraph pack/unpack in isolation and omitted decode_trace_record, which still replayed
bond matrices are sparse and gzip well

measured_on: real edit_precompile_v1 corruption/validation shard_0000 (1,985 traces, 7,854 states)
root_cause_of_the_load_cost: decode_trace_record replays every step through the executor UNCONDITIONALLY -- `validate` gates only the canonical-key comparisons, not the replay, because the final state is needed as `target`. TraceProgressCTMC.__init__ then replays a SECOND time. Each apply() runs is_valid_state -> is_rdkit_valid -> molecular_graph_to_smiles, ~32 RDKit round-trips per record per replay.
safety_trade: skipping replay means executor drift is no longer caught by re-execution at load; it is caught by refusing a store whose operator_registry_hash/codec_implementation_hash provenance disagrees, plus an on-demand verify_fraction replay audit (2% costs 0.47 ms/trace)
